metadata.description: Synthetic demonstration department directory for CivicSarthi platform

departments.name: Public Works Department (Roads & Infrastructure)
departments.description: Responsible for state highways, major district roads, bridges, and public infrastructure maintenance.

departments.name: Electricity Department (State Power Distribution)
departments.description: Handles high and low-tension grid distribution, transformers, residential meters, and outage restoration.

departments.name: Water Supply Department (Municipal Jal Board)
departments.description: Manages potable drinking water pipeline distribution, water treatment plants, and sewer networks.

departments.name: Health Department (Directorate of Health Services)
departments.description: Supervises government civil hospitals, primary health centres, drug availability, and public health schemes.

departments.name: Education Department (Higher Education & Scholarships)
departments.description: Administers student welfare stipends, DBT scholarship disbursement, and government educational institutes.

departments.name: Revenue Department (Land & District Administration)
departments.description: Handles land records, demarcation, certificates, revenue disputes, and district ex-gratia relief.

departments.name: Municipal Corporation (Urban Local Body)
departments.description: Oversees municipal sanitation, solid waste collection, street lighting, drainage cleaning, and parks.

departments.name: Social Welfare & Pension Department
departments.description: Coordinates senior citizen pensions, disability pensions, widow benefits, and pensioner grievance resolution.

departments.name: Police Department (Civic Liaison & Traffic)
departments.description: Manages civic grievance verification, traffic bottleneck enforcement, and public safety coordination.

departments.name: Department of Food & Public Distribution (PDS)
departments.description: Regulates Fair Price Shops (FPS), e-PoS ration distribution, and NFSA consumer food grain allocation.

departments.name: Disaster Management Authority
departments.description: Coordinates emergency crisis response, monsoon flood rescue, ex-gratia distribution, and relief shelters.
